about: Backend Engineer with hands-on experience in Node.js, TypeScript and NestJS, focused on building and evolving REST APIs, system integrations and corporate platforms. Over the last few years my work has been centered on multi-tenant environments with PostgreSQL, Prisma and RabbitMQ, and on developing and maintaining SailPoint connectors for identity provisioning.

I have consistent exposure to AWS (EKS, EC2, ECR, S3, Aurora, SQS, IAM), Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines on GitHub Actions and GitOps-based deploys with FluxCD. I have worked on release engineering (semantic versioning, conventional commits) and on production incident investigation, participating in RCA and postmortem processes. My full-stack awareness with React and Next.js is a complementary skill set, used when a delivery also requires frontend work.
I continuously work on deepening distributed architecture, observability, security and technical decision-making to grow my technical responsibility over backend systems.
See a brief overview of my skills, knowledge, education and experiences over the years.

experiences.name: CONTRACTLABS SISTEMAS LTDA / RAISE IT
describe: I worked on the development of the multi-tenant SaaS ecosystem for third-party/vendor management and identity, with two systems in Node.js/TypeScript/NestJS - ContractFlow (contractor, vendor, allocation and contract management) and IAM (identity, permissions, authentication providers, API keys and audit). Each customer runs a dedicated database per environment (dev/hml/prod).
- Designed and evolved REST APIs in Node.js/TypeScript/NestJS across the ContractFlow and IAM systems, with Zod validation.
- Architected the multi-tenant setup and helped shape decisions on schema isolation, tenant provisioning and database lifecycle.
- Owned three production SailPoint SaaS connectors (main ContractLabs connector plus two partner connectors).
- Modeled and maintained the database with PostgreSQL + Prisma, including an internal audit library that recorded actions originating from HTTP requests or RabbitMQ queues.
- Built the custom notifications module, the IAM frontend in Next.js and the mapping of SAML groups into IAM permissions (corporate SSO per tenant).
- Maintained the release pipeline with GitHub Actions (semantic versioning, conventional commits) and GitOps/FluxCD deploys with images in AWS ECR applied to the cluster.
- Investigated and resolved production incidents, participating in RCA and postmortem processes; wrote automated tests (unit and integration) with Vitest/Jest.
- Helped shape architectural decisions, reviewed pull requests, helped define team standards and mentored teammates.

experiences.name: CODEBORGES
describe: I have been working as a freelance developer since 2022, focused on Node.js/TypeScript backend and on building SaaS-style products of my own. The standout project is Nexus, a SaaS in development for event, freelancer and attendee management, with multi-tenancy, geolocation-based check-in and financial reporting.
- Develop backend APIs and applications in Node.js, TypeScript and NestJS, including relational database modeling and integration with external services.

- Designed and maintained Nexus, a SaaS in development for event, freelancer and attendee management. The product features multi-tenancy per company, venue management, freelancer scaling and payout with geolocation-based check-in/checkout (with photo capture), event management, ticketing, speaker management, attendee management, certificate generation, financial reporting, template-based email sending and action auditing.
- Implemented Docker and CI/CD environments for production projects, deployed to a self-hosted server.
- Also deliver occasional institutional websites and e-commerce projects on demand.

experiences.name: ARCOS - Supermarket Purchasing Network Association
describe: ARCOS is a supermarket purchasing association that ran a legacy PL/SQL system for sales and price research. I contributed to the migration to Node.js (EJS) and built a parallel WMS for inventory management (web + mobile).
- Migrated the legacy PL/SQL system to Node.js, owning backend evolution and the UI for the sales system.

- Built, end-to-end, an offline-first PWA for in-field price research used by store associates. The app assigned the visit location, captured product photos via camera and recorded values; the whole operation had to work without internet. IndexedDB (chosen and implemented by me within the team) provided local storage with broad device compatibility. I published a utility library on NPM wrapping IndexedDB access - dependency-free, secure and easy to maintain.
- Evolved the price analysis and per-category pricing modules and started planning the company's new WMS platform.

- On the WMS web platform: built the initial data migration baseline, integrated with partner ERPs and implemented the visual warehouse mapping screen (distributor → warehouse → aisles → buildings → floors → cells) with color-coded categorization.

- On the WMS mobile platform (React Native): contacted the data collector manufacturer, implemented login, the goods receiving flow with barcode scanning, blind reconciliation, recounts, label printing, storage based on the administrator-defined mapping, movement/relocation, audit logging and inventory adjustment with on-site physical verification when divergence was detected.

experiences.name: X-Point Soluções Tecnológicas
describe: X-Point was a regional software house with established products - including DataDivas, a POS focused on restaurant management already consolidated in the region - and new on-demand projects for external clients, including integration with Stone's card terminal.

- Technical analysis of how to integrate a React Native application with Stone's card terminal (for the waiter system). The analysis was mine; the implementation of the features that used the terminal's capabilities was carried out by the rest of the team.
- Built the frontend of a gas ordering system, consuming the backend API and allowing users to find the nearest store and place an order through the app.
- Provided support for the DataDivas POS to customers, exclusively via AnyDesk and TeamViewer.
